name: Faction
description: Organizations with goals, resources, hierarchy, allies, and enemies

fields.goal: Make dangerous travel and exploration profitable but survivable.
fields.resources: Maps, chapterhouses, veteran guides, rescue funds.
fields.hierarchy: Elected guildmaster, regional captains, licensed members.
fields.enemies: Bandit leagues, fraudulent guides, territorial nobles.

fields.goal: Secure a royal marriage and control the western river trade.
fields.resources: Fertile estates, cavalry, marriage ties, river tolls.
fields.hierarchy: Duchess, family council, sworn household officers.
fields.enemies: A rival duke, republican reformers, smugglers.

fields.goal: Find and safely destroy undead outbreaks before panic spreads.
fields.resources: Exorcists, sanctified fire, hidden hospices, burial records.
fields.hierarchy: High Keeper, lantern-bearers, lay informants.
fields.enemies: Necromancers, corpse merchants, officials hiding outbreaks.

fields.goal: Standardize weights, contracts, and currency across the region.
fields.resources: Warehouses, caravans, banks, hired guards.
fields.hierarchy: Board of factors, auditors, member companies.
fields.enemies: Counterfeiters, protection rackets, isolationist lords.

fields.goal: Control contraband without allowing uncontrolled street violence.
fields.resources: Smuggling routes, bribed guards, safehouses, informants.
fields.hierarchy: Hidden council, district bosses, crews.
fields.enemies: Independent gangs, honest magistrates, rival smugglers.

fields.goal: Prevent settlement from crossing ancient ecological boundaries.
fields.resources: Shape-shifters, sacred groves, animal messengers, weather lore.
fields.hierarchy: Seasonal council and autonomous local circles.
fields.enemies: Logging consortiums, expanding barons, blight cults.

fields.goal: Win land and legal recognition after decades of foreign wars.
fields.resources: Disciplined infantry, engineers, siege equipment, veterans.
fields.hierarchy: Marshal, banner captains, elected sergeants.
fields.enemies: Unpaid former employers, aristocratic officers, deserters.

fields.goal: Collect dangerous knowledge and restrict access to it.
fields.resources: Secret libraries, translators, memory magic, academic agents.
fields.hierarchy: Curators, sealed committees, field researchers.
fields.enemies: Book burners, reckless collectors, forbidden-text dealers.

fields.goal: Force coastal states to recognize a free maritime territory.
fields.resources: Fast ships, island coves, stolen charts, coastal spies.
fields.hierarchy: Elected admiral and captains' moot.
fields.enemies: Royal navies, slave traders, merchant monopolies.

fields.goal: Remove leaders judged likely to cause mass suffering.
fields.resources: Disguises, poisons, intelligence networks, false identities.
fields.hierarchy: Anonymous judges, handlers, isolated operatives.
fields.allies: Whistleblowers, spies, a few reformist nobles.
fields.enemies: Secret police, tyrants, assassins for hire.

fields.goal: Secure fair contracts, safe workplaces, and political representation.
fields.resources: Strike funds, skilled labor, meeting halls, public support.
fields.hierarchy: Local delegates and a rotating central committee.
fields.enemies: Exploitative guildmasters, strikebreakers, corrupt courts.

fields.goal: Restore lawful roads and defend communities abandoned by the crown.
fields.resources: Fortified keeps, trained cavalry, squires, public prestige.
fields.hierarchy: Grand commander, castellans, sworn knights.
fields.enemies: Raiders, corrupt nobles, monsters controlling roads.

fields.goal: Replace hereditary rule with elected regional councils.
fields.resources: Pamphlet presses, neighborhood cells, defectors, donations.
fields.hierarchy: Secret congress, local speakers, independent cells.
fields.enemies: Royal intelligence, conservative clergy, loyalist militias.

fields.goal: Silence every source of sound to awaken a sleeping god.
fields.resources: Fanatical converts, silence magic, infiltrated musicians.
fields.hierarchy: Mute prophet, conductors, choristers.
fields.enemies: Bards, bell-founders, nearly every established religion.

fields.goal: Make neighboring states economically dependent without open war.
fields.resources: Diplomats, loans, luxury goods, trained agents.
fields.hierarchy: Ambassador, commercial attachés, covert office.
fields.allies: Debtor nobles, import guilds, cosmopolitan elites.
fields.enemies: Protectionists, rival diplomats, local intelligence services.

fields.goal: End slavery and relocate freed people beyond retaliation.
fields.resources: Safehouses, forged papers, sympathetic sailors, hidden funds.
fields.hierarchy: Independent routes coordinated by masked dispatchers.
fields.allies: Former slaves, abolitionist temples, dock unions.
fields.enemies: Traffickers, plantation lords, bounty hunters.

fields.goal: Control sovereign debt and make warfare financially impossible without them.
fields.resources: Vaults, credit ledgers, debt collectors, political leverage.
fields.hierarchy: Five partner families and professional clerks.
fields.enemies: Debtors' movements, counterfeiters, competing banks.

fields.goal: Recover celestial objects before governments weaponize them.
fields.resources: Observatories, mages, expedition teams, meteor fragments.
fields.hierarchy: Scientific council, principal investigators, apprentices.
fields.enemies: War ministries, artifact smugglers, cosmic cults.

fields.goal: Monopolize rare toxins and the antidotes that control them.
fields.resources: Hidden gardens, alchemists, apothecary fronts, blackmail files.
fields.hierarchy: Master gardeners, distributors, contracted collectors.
fields.enemies: Healers, rival alchemists, victims' families.

fields.goal: Keep local defense under community control rather than noble armies.
fields.resources: Volunteers, town arsenals, watchtowers, local knowledge.
fields.hierarchy: Elected captains accountable to public assemblies.
fields.enemies: Invaders, would-be warlords, nobles demanding disarmament.

fields.goal: Locate anomalous objects, transport them safely, study their limits, and contain those that cannot be destroyed.
fields.resources: Specialized vaults, insulated transport cases, catalogues of incidents, and recovery teams.
fields.hierarchy: Field recoverers answer to vault keepers, who each control only the procedures needed for their assigned collection.
fields.allies: Careful scholars, communities threatened by dangerous relics, and rulers willing to fund discreet storage.
fields.enemies: Relic traffickers, apocalyptic cults, reckless collectors, and escaped objects that can choose their own holders.

fields.type: A scholarly society with intelligent undead among its senior members
fields.goal: Preserve research, experiments, archives, and institutional memory across centuries without surrendering intellectual freedom.
fields.resources: Living laboratories, sealed archives, patient patrons, and undead scholars who personally remember ancient projects.
fields.hierarchy: Short-lived fellows lead current work while senior chairs retain custody of studies spanning several generations.
fields.allies: Universities, archivists, healers, and rulers who value durable expertise.
fields.enemies: Undead hunters, grave robbers, plagiarists, and members who manipulate history by claiming only they remember it correctly.

fields.goal: Study territories, breeding, food chains, migration, and conflict before deciding whether a creature should be relocated, controlled, negotiated with, or killed.
fields.resources: Field bestiaries, trackers, anatomists, mobile cages, antidotes, and agreements with frontier communities.
fields.hierarchy: Regional ecologists assess cases before licensed hunters accept a contract and document its outcome.
fields.allies: Farmers, naturalists, cautious monster communities, and officials facing recurring attacks.
fields.enemies: Trophy hunters, poachers, frightened mobs, and patrons who conceal how their own actions disrupted an ecosystem.

fields.type: An expeditionary society for temporary portals and unstable places
fields.goal: Discover vanishing openings, map what lies beyond, and recover people and objects before every known route closes.
fields.resources: Rapid-response explorers, synchronized clocks, anchor beacons, portable camps, and an archive of expired routes.
fields.hierarchy: Pathfinders lead individual crossings while route archivists decide which unstable openings justify an expedition.
fields.allies: Missing-person networks, curious scholars, merchants seeking brief opportunities, and settlements divided by anomalies.
fields.enemies: Portal predators, stranded rivals, secretive authorities, and clients who lie about what was lost beyond a closing route.

fields.type: A neutral guild of magically enforced contracts
fields.goal: Make high-stakes agreements credible by recording them and binding deliberate violations to stated supernatural consequences.
fields.resources: Trusted witnesses, secure archives, ritual seals, traveling arbiters, and experts in ambiguous wording.
fields.hierarchy: Licensed witnesses register ordinary agreements while a masked council reviews contracts capable of harming whole communities.
fields.allies: Merchants, diplomats, lenders, rulers, and anyone whose agreement must survive distance or mistrust.
fields.enemies: Oathbreakers, coercive patrons, counterfeit registrars, and literal-minded entities that exploit badly written clauses.
